tokens.name: --color-ground
tokens.description: Deepest app background. Behind video, behind everything.

tokens.name: --color-surface
tokens.description: Default panel surface: sidebar, side panels, settings pages.

tokens.name: --color-raised
tokens.description: Raised surface: popovers, dialogs, hovered rows, input fields.

tokens.name: --color-hairline
tokens.description: Default 1px separator. Does most of the layout work in place of cards.

tokens.name: --color-hairline-strong
tokens.description: Stronger border for focused inputs and active tile outlines.

tokens.name: --color-text
tokens.description: Primary text.

tokens.name: --color-text-muted
tokens.description: Secondary text, descriptions, inactive nav labels.

tokens.name: --color-text-faint
tokens.description: Tertiary text. 5.57:1 on ground, 5.19:1 on surface, 4.74:1 on raised — clears WCAG AA on every surface in the set. Never below 10px.

tokens.name: --color-primary
tokens.description: The one accent. Markers, focus rings, selected state, fills. NEVER small text — it is 3.50:1 on ground, which passes 3:1 as a graphic but fails 4.5:1 as text. Use --color-primary-soft for rust text.

tokens.name: --color-primary-deep
tokens.description: Pressed state and brand mark. Matches --keeppeek-rust in ui/src/app.css.

tokens.name: --color-primary-soft
tokens.description: Rust tint for text on dark and hover states.

tokens.name: --color-on-primary
tokens.description: Text and icons placed on a rust fill.

tokens.name: --color-live
tokens.description: DEMANDS ATTENTION. Hard failure, camera offline, and the timeline's now/LIVE marker. NOT the REC indicator — recording is the expected state and stays quiet (bone dot in a neutral pill), so that on a wall of 127 healthy cameras red appears only where something is wrong. White on this fill clears 4.5:1; the fill clears 3:1 as a graphic.

tokens.name: --color-activity
tokens.description: Timeline motion and activity bands. Also warning severity.

tokens.name: --color-healthy
tokens.description: Healthy system state, connected camera, successful stream test.

tokens.name: --color-availability
tokens.description: Recorded footage exists for this span. Sits under activity bands. 3.23:1 on ground, 3.01:1 on surface — meets WCAG 1.4.11 for information-bearing graphics, because absence of this band is how an operator sees a gap.

tokens.name: --color-live-text
tokens.description: Red TEXT on dark surfaces: offline durations, critical counts, destructive labels. --color-live is a fill token and measures only 3.61:1 as text on surface, so it must never carry a red word. This clears 4.5:1 on ground, surface, raised and hairline alike.

tokens.name: --color-video
tokens.description: Video letterbox surface. Sits below --color-ground so a frame reads as an aperture rather than a panel. Was an undeclared literal on 43 elements before it was named.

tokens.name: --light-ground
tokens.description: Light theme ground. Warm, derived from the --keeppeek-paper brand value rather than a neutral white — a pure white ground next to video reads as a blown highlight.

tokens.name: --light-surface
tokens.description: Light theme panel surface. Sits above ground, as in dark.

tokens.name: --light-raised
tokens.description: Light theme raised surface: popovers, dialogs, inputs. The only pure white in the system.

tokens.name: --light-hairline
tokens.description: Light theme 1px separator.

tokens.name: --light-hairline-strong
tokens.description: Light theme stronger border for focused inputs and active outlines.

tokens.name: --light-text
tokens.description: Light theme primary text. 14.25:1 on ground.

tokens.name: --light-text-muted
tokens.description: Light theme secondary text. 6.24:1 on ground.

tokens.name: --light-text-faint
tokens.description: Light theme tertiary text. 5.16:1 on ground, 6.29:1 on raised. Same 10px floor as dark.

tokens.name: --light-primary-text
tokens.description: Light theme rust text. --color-primary itself clears 4.5:1 on the light ground, but this deeper value keeps the same one-step-darker rule the dark theme uses for text.

tokens.name: --light-live-text
tokens.description: Light theme red TEXT. --color-live is only 4.12:1 on the light ground, so red words darken here exactly as they lighten in dark.

tokens.name: --light-activity
tokens.description: Light theme activity band and warning fill. 3.36:1 on ground — clears the graphics threshold that #E8A33D fails against a light background.

tokens.name: --light-activity-text
tokens.description: Light theme warning text.

tokens.name: --light-healthy
tokens.description: Light theme healthy fill. 3.41:1 on ground.

tokens.name: --light-healthy-text
tokens.description: Light theme healthy text.

tokens.name: --light-availability
tokens.description: Light theme availability band. 3.23:1 on ground — the same ratio the dark band carries, because absence of this band is how a gap is seen in either theme.

tokens.name: --font-mono
tokens.description: All technical values: timestamps, bitrates, codecs, IDs, labels in caps.

tokens.name: --text-xs
tokens.description: Caps labels and mono micro-labels only.

tokens.name: --text-sm
tokens.description: Dense data rows, table cells, captions.

tokens.name: --text-2xs
tokens.description: Mono micro-label inside dense chrome: tile overlays, table sub-values, badge numerals. Caps with --tracking-caps only, never sentence case. This is the floor — nothing in the product renders below 10px.

tokens.name: --text-md
tokens.description: Between --text-sm and --text-base. Mobile row titles and dense sans values that 13px renders too tight for.

tokens.name: --text-lg-plus
tokens.description: Mobile section and card headings. Below --text-xl, above --text-lg.

tokens.name: --text-xs-plus
tokens.description: Between --text-xs and --text-sm. The workhorse of dense chrome: status bars, chips, table sub-labels, inline captions. Sans and mono both use it.

tokens.name: --text-5xl
tokens.description: Masthead display, board 01 only. One use in the whole system — if a second screen needs it, the screen is wrong.

tokens.name: --tracking-caps
tokens.description: Mono caps labels.

tokens.name: --container-rail
tokens.description: Icon-only rail width.

tokens.name: --container-timeline
tokens.description: Vertical timeline strip width.

tokens.name: --container-sidebar
tokens.description: Expanded sidebar with labels.

tokens.name: --container-panel
tokens.description: Right-hand events / filter panel.

tokens.name: --radius-lg
tokens.description: Video tiles and event thumbnails.
